what: Statistical invariants (do not violate; test at these boundaries)
title: circumplex — assistant instructions
text: Angles: degrees [0, 360) user API, LM = 360 0 (norms tables octants() use 360). Radians internally via circumplex_degree/circumplex_radian S3 classes. Contrasts: second minus first factor level (alphabetical unless factor), reported (-180°, 180°] via angle_dist(). Displacement CIs use circular quantiles (center circular mean, unwrap, quantile, re-wrap); contrast CIs may legitimately negative, reported branch estimate (endpoints may exceed ±180° near boundary; see cairn/DESIGN.md). change touching displacement, contrasts, src/ requires tests : profiles peaking 0°/360°, CIs straddling 0°/360°, contrasts near ±180°, flat (zero-variance) profiles. Closed-form SSM estimator equals OLS equally spaced angles (exact condition: first+second harmonic balance — equal spacing sufficient, necessary; cairn/DESIGN.md). SEM layer (ssm_sem*) always uses OLS projection instead.

code: results <- ssm_analyze(   jz2017,   scales = PANO(),   measures = c("NARPD", "ASPD") ) results$results[, c("Label", "a_est", "d_est", "a_lci", "a_uci")] #>   Label    a_est    d_est     a_lci     a_uci #> 1 NARPD 0.189244 108.9667 0.1537900 0.2271848 #> 2  ASPD 0.226159 115.9267 0.1905403 0.2640428 amax <- 1  ggcircumplex(octants(), labels = PANO(), amax = amax) +   geom_ssm_arc(     data = results$results,     mapping = aes(       amplitude_min = a_lci, amplitude_max = a_uci,       displacement_min = d_lci, displacement_max = d_uci,       fill = Label     ),     amax = amax, alpha = 0.4, color = NA   ) +   geom_ssm_point(     data = results$results,     mapping = aes(amplitude = a_est, displacement = d_est, fill = Label),     amax = amax   )

code: # Per-person SSM parameters for a subset of the sample. A respondent whose # scores are flat has no displacement and is returned as NA (with a warning), # so we keep only the well-defined profiles. people <- ssm_score(   jz2017[1:100, ],   scales = PANO(),   append = FALSE ) people <- people[!is.na(people$Disp), ]  # Group-level profile for the same subset group <- ssm_analyze(jz2017[1:100, ], scales = PANO())  amax <- 3  ggcircumplex(octants(), labels = PANO(), amax = amax) +   geom_ssm_point(     data = people,     mapping = aes(amplitude = Ampl, displacement = Disp),     amax = amax, fill = "grey70", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6   ) +   geom_ssm_point(     data = group$results,     mapping = aes(amplitude = a_est, displacement = d_est),     amax = amax, fill = "#0072B2", size = 4   )

title: Calculate latent SSM parameters from a fitted lavaan measurement model — ssm_sem_parameters
code: # \donttest{ data("jz2017") scales <- c("PA", "BC", "DE", "FG", "HI", "JK", "LM", "NO") syn <- ssm_sem_syntax(scales = scales, angles = octants(), measures = "NARPD") # Robust (sandwich) SEs so the mvn engine propagates a # misspecification-consistent covariance (ssm_sem()'s default) fit <- lavaan::cfa(syn, data = jz2017, se = "robust.huber.white") set.seed(12345) ssm_sem_parameters(fit, scales = scales, measures = "NARPD", boots = 500) #>  #> # Latent (SEM-based) SSM #>  #> Measurement model:	 scaled fixed-angle circumplex #> Global fit (N = 1166): chisq(17) = 356.099, p < 0.001  #> 			CFI = 0.93, RMSEA = 0.131, SRMR = 0.072 #>  #> # Profile [NARPD]: #>  #>                Estimate   Lower CI   Upper CI #> Elevation         0.249      0.210      0.295 #> X-Value          -0.009     -0.054      0.033 #> Y-Value           0.231      0.189      0.273 #> Amplitude         0.232      0.192      0.274 #> Displacement     92.132     82.515    104.461 #> Model Fit         0.975                       #>  # }

title: Generate lavaan syntax for a fixed-angle circumplex measurement model — ssm_sem_syntax
text: Two model tiers available. "scaled" tier frees general saturation circumplex saturation per scale fixing scale's angle; circumplex plane held isotropic orthogonal, general factor held orthogonal plane (freeing general-plane covariances alongside free saturations makes model locally unidentified exactly zero covariance, estimated tier). "strict" tier fixes every loading unit cosine pattern (1, cos(angle), sin(angle)) frees 3x3 factor covariance matrix – including general-plane covariances, making tier can model general factor leaning plane. angles enter evaluated cosine sine constants; angle ever free parameter. returned string always carries weights attribute: ordinary-least-squares projection matrix maps profile vector structural summary coordinates (e, x, y). equally spaced angles equals conventional closed-form estimator; unequally spaced angles least-squares projection can differ. emitted syntax never contains := definitions amplitude displacement: nonlinear functions whose confidence intervals must constructed -package, lavaan's delta method (ignores angular branch cut).

title: Generate lavaan syntax for a fixed-angle circumplex measurement model — ssm_sem_syntax
code: # Octant instrument, default scaled tier syn <- ssm_sem_syntax(scales = paste0("s", 1:8), angles = octants()) attr(syn, "weights") #>             s1         s2            s3         s4            s5         s6 #> e 1.250000e-01  0.1250000  1.250000e-01  0.1250000  1.250000e-01  0.1250000 #> x 1.941169e-17 -0.1767767 -2.500000e-01 -0.1767767 -5.696675e-17  0.1767767 #> y 2.500000e-01  0.1767767  2.998201e-17 -0.1767767 -2.500000e-01 -0.1767767 #>              s7        s8 #> e  1.250000e-01 0.1250000 #> x  2.500000e-01 0.1767767 #> y -4.672039e-17 0.1767767 cat(syn) #> # circumplex SSM measurement model (generated by ssm_sem_syntax()) #> # scales: s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8 #> # angles (degrees): 90, 135, 180, 225, 270, 315, 360, 45 #> # model tier: scaled #>  #> # general factor: free per-scale saturations #> g =~ NA*s1 + a1*s1 + a2*s2 + a3*s3 + a4*s4 + a5*s5 + a6*s6 + a7*s7 + a8*s8 #> # circumplex plane: loadings free but with each scale's angle fixed #> cx =~ NA*s1 + lx1*s1 + lx2*s2 + lx3*s3 + lx4*s4 + lx5*s5 + lx6*s6 + lx7*s7 + lx8*s8 #> cy =~ NA*s1 + ly1*s1 + ly2*s2 + ly3*s3 + ly4*s4 + ly5*s5 + ly6*s6 + ly7*s7 + ly8*s8 #> # fixed-angle direction constraints: sin(a)*lx - cos(a)*ly == 0 #> 0 == 1*lx1 - 0*ly1 #> 0 == 0.70710678118654757*lx2 - -0.70710678118654746*ly2 #> 0 == 0*lx3 - -1*ly3 #> 0 == -0.70710678118654746*lx4 - -0.70710678118654768*ly4 #> 0 == -1*lx5 - 0*ly5 #> 0 == -0.70710678118654768*lx6 - 0.70710678118654735*ly6 #> 0 == 0*lx7 - 1*ly7 #> 0 == 0.70710678118654746*lx8 - 0.70710678118654757*ly8 #> # isotropic orthonormal plane metric (plane scale absorbed by loadings) #> g ~~ 1*g #> cx ~~ 1*cx #> cy ~~ 1*cy #> cx ~~ 0*cy #> # general-plane covariances fixed to zero: with free per-scale #> # saturations, freeing these is locally unidentified exactly at #> # phi_g = 0 (the trade a_i +/- d*c_i*cos/sin(angle_i) <-> phi_g is #> # first-order flat there), so they cannot be estimated. To model a #> # general factor leaning into the plane, use the strict tier, whose #> # fixed loadings leave the full factor covariance matrix free. #> g ~~ 0*cx #> g ~~ 0*cy #>  #> # NOTE: amplitude (a) and displacement (d) are deliberately NOT defined #> # here. They are nonlinear (sqrt / atan2) and their intervals must be #> # built in-package through circular quantiles, never via lavaan := or #> # delta-method CIs (which ignore the angular branch cut).

title: circumplex 1.2.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-07-02 SSM plotting functions (ssm_plot_circle(), ssm_plot_curve(), ssm_plot_contrast()) now warn given unrecognized argument (e.g., misspelled parameter name) instead silently ignoring . Matrix input now works wherever documented. ssm_analyze(), ssm_score(), ipsatize(), score(), norm_standardize(), self_standardize() previously errored given matrix despite advertising matrix support; now coerce data frame internally. ssm_score() now accepts numeric column indexes scales (e.g., scales = 1:8), consistent documentation ssm_analyze(); previously required character names. Printing SSM object (via print() summary()) now adds note profile whose model fit inadequate (R-squared < .70; interpret elevation) whose amplitude confidence interval includes zero (displacement interpretable). notes apply profiles , contrast rows. Contrast displacement estimates confidence intervals now always reported angular branch. Previously, contrasts near ±180 degrees, estimate (reported (-180, 180]) fall numerically outside confidence interval geometrically inside, interval centered bootstrap circular mean’s branch. interval now shifted full circle needed (width meaning unchanged; results away boundary identical), interval endpoints may exceed ±180 degrees contrast straddles boundary. norm_standardize() now matches scale normative data angular position rather exact numeric equality, 0 360 degrees treated angle (previously passing 0 scale stored 360 failed cryptic error). angle matching normative row, one, now produces informative error naming available angles. Degenerate profiles now handled explicitly instead returning numerical noise. flat (zero-variance) profile returns NA displacement fit warning (previously arbitrary angle -Inf); profile real variance zero amplitude returns NA displacement fit 0. Bootstrap resamples produce degenerate profiles (e.g., resampled measure zero variance) longer crash ssm_analyze(); excluded confidence intervals warning reporting count. Genuinely small amplitudes unaffected — degeneracy test operates machine-noise scale . Fixed bug missing (NA) value grouping variable ssm_analyze() crashed cryptic error pairwise deletion (listwise = FALSE). observations now dropped analysis message reporting many removed, deletion modes; observations remain, clear error given. Fixed bug length requirements character arguments never enforced (is_null_or_char() dropped n argument). ssm_analyze() now errors measures_labels match number measures (given without measures), ssm_plot_circle()/ssm_plot_curve() now error angle_labels match number angles (previously mismatched labels silently recycled onto wrong scales), ssm_table()/html_render() now require caption single string. Fixed bug ssm_score() silently ignored angles argument always used octants(): custom angle sets length produced incorrect results without warning, angle sets different length (e.g., poles() four scales) errored. Results ssm_score() default angles = octants() unaffected. (found 2026-07 audit)
